law.name: Fold Graph recoverable contraction
law.shape: G_F(h) = (V_h, E→_h, B_h, W_h, tau_h, Theta_h)
law.orientation: O_E is permitted traversal direction; W_E is only relationship strength
law.phase_forward: runtime paths satisfy semantic edge orientation plus C6 phase-forward law
law.handle: Handle(h) is an addressable contracted graph state
law.equivalence: semantic/topological equivalence under the Fold contract, not necessarily byte identity
law.locality: Local Fold Validity + Boundary Compatibility => Composable Fold Validity
law.analogy_boundary: Demaine/Abel graph-folding analogy is useful but non-equivalent and non-authoritative
law.xul_topology_boundary: Only verified/authorized Xul can persist delta_B
law.pattern_lineage: regex -> SNOBOL -> FoldGraph: pattern_as_syntax -> pattern_as_composable_value -> pattern_as_graph_generating_constraint
law.foldgraph_2d_bit_pattern: Anaψ=sliding window generation; Pattern=((window ^ pattern) & mask); Attention=popcount score; Cataφ=argmax reduction.
law.inference_field_2d_surface: The inference field provides the graph/matrix surface for 2D FoldGraph bit-pattern matching.

layers.FoldField: vertex in G_runtime = G_semantic □ G_phase; fields: node_id, theta, W, C, R; score()=W*C*R
layers.ProductGraph: G_runtime = G_semantic □ G_phase; vertex=(node_id, phase); edge=W_arc·cos(Δθ)
layers.ConvergenceTest: Kleene iteration tracker over FoldStates; CONVERGED when d<epsilon; k=d_n/d_{n-1}<k_max

phase_orientation: C6 phase-forward: Pop -> Wo -> Yax -> Sek -> Ch'en -> Xul -> Pop'

invariants.FG1: Fold Graph is not Fold Space, Fold Field, Fold Event, or persistent global topology
invariants.FG2: Unfold(h,tau) reveals relationships represented by B_tau[h,e] != 0; it does not create semantic relationships
invariants.FG4: Yax derives G_F^Q(h) from G_F(h) using a query gate; it does not unfold the whole universe
invariants.FG5: Sek operates on Active Fold Graph, not persistent topology directly
invariants.FG6: Handle(h) is an addressable contracted graph state
invariants.FG7: Unfold(Fold(G_F)) ~= G_F under semantic/topological Fold contract equivalence
invariants.FG8: JSON Book projections may be lossy while canonical incidence/bytecode preserves recoverable structure
invariants.FG9: Local Fold Validity + Boundary Compatibility => Composable Fold Validity
invariants.FG10: Fold does not destroy the graph
invariants.FG11: Only verified/authorized Xul can persist delta_B
invariants.FG12: Demaine/Abel graph-folding is analogy only, not a claimed equivalence or source of authority
invariants.FG13: Edge weight W_E does not imply traversal permission; O_E declares legal direction
invariants.FG14: A valid runtime path must satisfy semantic edge orientation and C6 phase-forward orientation
invariants.FG15: @node is the root of a Fold; the Fold is the algebra applied to the structure rooted there. @node != fold.
invariants.FG16: G_runtime = G_semantic □ G_phase. FoldField vertex = (node_id, theta, W, C, R). Edge weight = W_arc·cos(θ_b−θ_a).
invariants.FG17: Kleene iteration: µf = ⊔{f^n(⊥)|n≥0}. Xul is the least fixed point. (Fold∘Unfold)(h)≡h identity invariant; violation drops sigma to UNBOUND.
invariants.FG18: §60: Pattern lineage is regex syntax -> SNOBOL first-class composable value -> FoldGraph graph-generating constraint; FoldGraph ranks candidates by WCR instead of committing to first success.
invariants.FG19: 2D FoldGraph bit-pattern matching is a projection over an inference field: Anaψ generates sliding windows, the pattern layer applies ((window ^ pattern) & mask), Attention uses popcount scoring, and Cataφ selects argmax.

ancestry.name: SNOBOL ancestry
lineage: SNOBOL: pattern as first-class composable runtime value
ancestry.foldgraph_law: P(Q,B) -> Ana -> F_Q -> WCR -> F*_Q -> Cata -> C_Q
